_about: Model-free drive test, written 2026-10-12 BEFORE any run. Each category carries a PREDICTION of the share of its prompts the fold can finish with zero model calls (a computed answer, a mechanical slot answer, a sources-only strand, or a typed refusal counts as 'finished without a model'; a turn that asks the model to speak does not). Predictions are frozen here; results are appended in RESULTS.md, nothing above is changed.
